## J06 — Staff Analytics Engineer — Ember Vale Platforms
Source [J06-SRC]: https://careers.example.com/ember-vale/staff-analytics-engineer (fictional posting dated 2026-09-05).
Company: fictional US finance-operations SaaS platform.
Location/authorization: US remote including Illinois, US work authorization, Central-compatible hours, travel 10%.
Level: staff IC, minimum eight years relevant professional experience AND prior ownership of multi-team analytics architecture and technical mentorship across at least three teams. These are mandatory; role is not downlevelable. No direct reports, but staff-wide influence is required.
Base salary: USD 180,000–205,000.
Work: set company-wide modeling standards, resolve architecture tradeoffs, mentor team leads, coordinate multi-quarter data strategy. SQL, dbt, Snowflake, GitHub Actions, Looker and finance metrics are core stack keywords.
Hiring process: staff architecture and cross-team leadership panels; not a mid-level opening.
